comment: Entry-trigger config for scripts/watchlist_monitor.py. Each entry has a `route` field: 'polyclaude' (script may auto-deploy on trigger) or 'ibkr_surface' (script Telegrams operator on trigger; operator executes via IBKR personal sleeve). Polyclaude horizon constraint per project memory 2026-05-08: bankroll locked to <1y holding horizon. Multi-year plays go to IBKR. Polyclaude-route requires: (a) <1y catalyst clock, (b) EVM-chain accessible (crypto on Uniswap V3 / wrapped tokens) — equities default to ibkr_surface regardless.
